description: Temper plugin hooks: deterministic standalone-stage gate guarantee. stage-marker.sh (UserPromptSubmit) records which gate a /temper:intent, /temper:plan, /temper:design, /temper:build, /temper:review or /temper:check session owes; verify-stage-gate.sh (Stop) refuses to end the session until the project's .temper/gates.json carries a verdict for it (any verdict, PASS or FAIL). Both fail open on every path except the one detected violation. See ADR 0005, deterministic stage gate enforcement, in the plugin's docs.
